title: Hand-Drawn 3D Look
idiom: Haeckel engraving meets Blender wireframe — precise naturalist linework applied to a 3D-sourced subject, capturing the marriage of computational scaffolding and hand-drawn surface
hero_prompt: Wide 12:5 panoramic, very dark charcoal-grey backdrop. A single human figure rendered as a precise naturalist pen-and-ink engraving in the tradition of Haeckel — cross-hatched, calligraphic strokes of varying weight — while faint wireframe geometry (the Blender scaffold) glows dim blue-grey behind and through it, just visible as an underpainting. The figure is poised mid-turn, coat catching wind, confident linework decisive not hesitant. A loose ink splatter drifts from the figure's shoulder into the right margin like a thought escaping into abstraction. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem on near-black ground. A single thick-stroke pen nib or calligraphy chisel set at an angle, its downstroke splitting into two parallel lines — one a clean vector edge, one a ragged ink bleed — suggesting the seam between 3D structure and hand-drawn surface. Heavy blacks, paper-white gaps, no fine linework that would vanish at 24px. No letters, numerals, words, labels.
